name: Learn — done button redirects back to lobby

planSteps.description: A done button with id 'learnDoneBtn' or text 'เรียนจบแล้ว' is visible
Click the button with text 'เรียนจบแล้ว' or id 'learnDoneBtn'
The button text changes to 'กำลังกลับ...' immediately after clicking
The page URL changes to '/lobby' within 2 seconds
